name: thread-fingerprint-legacy-rescue
description: Create a provisional handoff reference when Thread Fingerprint cannot run.

interface.shortDescription: Create a provisional legacy handoff reference.
interface.longDescription: Helps move an older or unsupported conversation into a separate new conversation by generating an explicitly non-MCP legacy reference and two handoff prompts. It does not identify, branch, connect, modify, or validate the legacy conversation.
defaultPrompt: Create a handoff reference for this old chat.
Help me continue this chat in a new conversation.
